keyEvents.text: Bosun Lawal (Stoke City) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
George Hirst (Stoke City) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Luca Bombino (Stoke City) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Christoph Klarer (Birmingham City) is shown the yellow card for handball.
First Half ends, Stoke City 0, Birmingham City 0.
Second Half begins Stoke City 0, Birmingham City 0.
Goal! Stoke City 1, Birmingham City 0. George Hirst (Stoke City) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Djibril Soumaré with a cross.
Jay Stansfield (Birmingham City) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Djibril Soumaré (Stoke City).
Substitution, Stoke City. Svante Ingelsson replaces Djibril Soumaré because of an injury.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Second yellow card to Luca Bombino (Stoke City) for a bad foul.
Substitution, Birmingham City. Demarai Gray replaces Liam Millar.
Substitution, Birmingham City. Max Bird replaces August Priske.
